text.en: Image workflows prefer the configured Codex image model when selecting from available subscription models.
text.zh-CN: 图片流程选择 Codex 订阅生图模型时，优先使用配置中的默认模型。

text.en: Wallpaper processing reviews generated images before ESPCN x3 super-resolution, preserves generated pixels without source overlays and checks final file dimensions without another model review.
text.zh-CN: 壁纸处理先复审生成图，通过后使用 ESPCN x3 超分；直接保留生图返回画面，不再回贴原图，最终校验尺寸和文件，不重复调用模型复审。

text.en: Add per-image replacement, cancellation and retry controls, a processing-history timeline and tighter workflow layouts. Recovery preserves saved generation receipts and unchanged approved outputs.
text.zh-CN: 完善单张图片的替换、取消与重试入口，增加历史处理时间线并优化节点排列；恢复任务时保留已保存生图回执及未变更图片的合格记录。

text.en: Improve image-edit prompts and review consistency for core subjects, supporting objects, intentional source crops and original textures. Wallpaper backgrounds no longer need special clock-area treatment unless explicitly configured.
text.zh-CN: 完善生图提示词与复审的一致性，区分核心主体、陪衬物和原图有意截断内容，保留原有画风及纹理；未配置时钟规则时，不再特意处理时钟区域。
